## Introduction 

Credit committees depend on timely, complete, and well‑structured loan packages. In practice, this process is often slowed by:

- Missing documents 
- Manual reminders 
- Last‑minute summaries 
- Fragmented communication 

This page presents a **lightweight agentic AI orchestrator** that automates the entire workflow — from document intake to executive summaries — using a clean Python architecture. 

The system uses: 

- An **Orchestrator** to manage the loan cycle 
- An **Intake Agent** to store documents 
- A **Checklist Agent** to validate completeness 
- A **Summary Agent** to generate executive summaries 
- A simple **state machine** to track progress 

The result is a repeatable, auditable, and scalable workflow for credit committees. 

---

## Workflow Diagram
```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    participant RM as Relationship Manager
    participant Intake as Intake Agent
    participant Checklist as Checklist Agent
    participant Orchestrator
    participant Summary as Summary Agent
    participant Committee

    RM->>Orchestrator: Start new loan cycle
    Orchestrator->>RM: Invite to upload documents

    RM->>Intake: Upload documents
    Intake->>Orchestrator: Document stored

    Orchestrator->>Checklist: Run completeness check
    Checklist->>Orchestrator: Missing items / complete

    Orchestrator->>RM: Reminder for missing documents

    Note over Orchestrator: At cutoff date

    Orchestrator->>Summary: Generate executive summary
    Summary->>Committee: Email summary package
    Orchestrator->>Orchestrator: Reset cycle

```

## Domain Model

```{python}
from enum import Enum
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Dict

class LoanCycleStatus(Enum):
    INITIATED = "initiated"
    COLLECTING_DOCS = "collecting_docs"
    READY_FOR_COMMITTEE = "ready_for_committee"
    COMPLETED = "completed"

@dataclass
class RequiredDocument:
    name: str
    description: str

@dataclass
class UploadedDocument:
    doc_id: str
    loan_id: str
    name: str
    uploaded_by: str
    uploaded_at: datetime
    location: str

@dataclass
class LoanApplication:
    loan_id: str
    rm_id: str
    borrower_name: str
    amount: float
    created_at: datetime
    cutoff_date: datetime
    status: LoanCycleStatus = LoanCycleStatus.INITIATED
    required_docs: List[RequiredDocument] = field(default_factory=list)
    uploaded_docs: List[UploadedDocument] = field(default_factory=list)
    metadata: Dict = field(default_factory=dict)

```

## Repository Layer

```{python}
class LoanRepository:
    def __init__(self):
        self._loans = {}

    def add(self, loan):
        self._loans[loan.loan_id] = loan

    def get(self, loan_id):
        return self._loans.get(loan_id)

    def update(self, loan):
        self._loans[loan.loan_id] = loan

    def list_active(self):
        return [
            l for l in self._loans.values()
            if l.status in {LoanCycleStatus.INITIATED, LoanCycleStatus.COLLECTING_DOCS}
        ]

```

## Agent Interfaces


```{python}
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod

class IntakeAgent(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def ingest_document(self, loan_id, rm_id, doc_name, location):
        ...

class ChecklistAgent(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def check_completeness(self, loan):
        ...

    @abstractmethod
    def build_reminder_message(self, loan, missing_docs):
        ...

class SummaryAgent(ABC):
    @abstractmethod
    def build_executive_summary(self, loan):
        ...

    @abstractmethod
    def build_committee_email(self, summaries):
        ...

```

## Simple Agent Implementations

### Intake Agent
```{python}
import uuid
from datetime import UTC
from datetime import datetime


class SimpleIntakeAgent(IntakeAgent):
    def __init__(self, repo):
        self.repo = repo

    def ingest_document(self, loan_id, rm_id, doc_name, location):
        loan = self.repo.get(loan_id)
        doc = UploadedDocument(
            doc_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            loan_id=loan_id,
            name=doc_name,
            uploaded_by=rm_id,
            uploaded_at=datetime.now(UTC),
            location=location,
        )
        loan.uploaded_docs.append(doc)
        loan.status = LoanCycleStatus.COLLECTING_DOCS
        self.repo.update(loan)
        return doc

```

### Checklist Agent
```{python}
class SimpleChecklistAgent(ChecklistAgent):
    def check_completeness(self, loan):
        uploaded = {d.name for d in loan.uploaded_docs}
        required = {r.name for r in loan.required_docs}
        missing = sorted(list(required - uploaded))
        return {"is_complete": len(missing) == 0, "missing_docs": missing}

    def build_reminder_message(self, loan, missing_docs):
        return (
            f"Loan {loan.loan_id} is missing:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"- {m}" for m in missing_docs)
        )

```


### Summary Agent (LLM‑ready)

```{python}
class DummySummaryAgent(SummaryAgent):
    def build_executive_summary(self, loan):
        return (
            f"Executive Summary for {loan.borrower_name}\n"
            f"Amount: {loan.amount}\n"
            f"Documents: {len(loan.uploaded_docs)} uploaded\n"
        )

    def build_committee_email(self, summaries):
        body = "\n\n".join(summaries.values())
        return f"Credit Committee Package\n\n{body}"

```

## Orchestrator

```{python}
class CreditCommitteeOrchestrator:
    def __init__(self, repo, intake, checklist, summary):
        self.repo = repo
        self.intake = intake
        self.checklist = checklist
        self.summary = summary

    def start_new_cycle(self, loan):
        self.repo.add(loan)

    def receive_document(self, loan_id, rm_id, doc_name, location):
        return self.intake.ingest_document(loan_id, rm_id, doc_name, location)

    def run_completeness_checks(self):
        for loan in self.repo.list_active():
            result = self.checklist.check_completeness(loan)
            if result["is_complete"]:
                loan.status = LoanCycleStatus.READY_FOR_COMMITTEE
                self.repo.update(loan)

    def close_cycle(self):
        summaries = {}
        for loan in self.repo._loans.values():
            if loan.status == LoanCycleStatus.READY_FOR_COMMITTEE:
                summaries[loan.loan_id] = self.summary.build_executive_summary(loan)
                loan.status = LoanCycleStatus.COMPLETED
                self.repo.update(loan)
        return self.summary.build_committee_email(summaries)

```

# Demo: Running a Full Cycle


```{python}
from datetime import datetime, UTC
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
now = datetime.now(UTC)

repo = LoanRepository()
intake = SimpleIntakeAgent(repo)
checklist = SimpleChecklistAgent()
summary = DummySummaryAgent()

orch = CreditCommitteeOrchestrator(repo, intake, checklist, summary)

loan = LoanApplication(
    loan_id="LN-001",
    rm_id="rm@example.com",
    borrower_name="Acme Corp",
    amount=5_000_000,
    created_at=datetime.now(UTC),
    cutoff_date=datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(days=3),
    required_docs=[
        RequiredDocument("Financials", "3-year audited"),
        RequiredDocument("Business Plan", "Projected cashflows")
    ]
)

orch.start_new_cycle(loan)

orch.receive_document("LN-001", "rm@example.com", "Financials", "s3://docs/fin.pdf")

orch.run_completeness_checks()

email = orch.close_cycle()
email
```


# Testing the system

In this section, we run an end‑to‑end scenario that exercises the full agentic workflow:

- Start a new loan cycle
- Upload documents
- Run completeness checks
- Close the cycle and generate the committee summary email

```{python}

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, UTC

# Fresh in-memory setup for this test
repo = LoanRepository()
intake = SimpleIntakeAgent(repo)
checklist = SimpleChecklistAgent()
summary = DummySummaryAgent()

orch = CreditCommitteeOrchestrator(repo, intake, checklist, summary)

# 1. Create a new loan cycle
loan = LoanApplication(
    loan_id="LN-TEST-001",
    rm_id="rm.tester@example.com",
    borrower_name="Test Corp",
    amount=1_000_000,
    created_at=datetime.now(UTC),
    cutoff_date=datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(days=2),
    required_docs=[
        RequiredDocument("Financials", "3-year audited"),
        RequiredDocument("Business Plan", "Projected cashflows")
    ]
)

orch.start_new_cycle(loan)

print("=== After starting new cycle ===")
print("Status:", loan.status)
print("Required docs:", [d.name for d in loan.required_docs])
print()

# 2. Upload one document (incomplete package)
orch.receive_document(
    loan_id="LN-TEST-001",
    rm_id="rm.tester@example.com",
    doc_name="Financials",
    location="s3://docs/ln-test-001-financials.pdf",
)

print("=== After uploading Financials ===")
print("Uploaded docs:", [d.name for d in loan.uploaded_docs])
print("Status:", loan.status)
print()

# 3. Run completeness checks
orch.run_completeness_checks()

print("=== After completeness check ===")
print("Status:", loan.status)
print()

# 4. Force-close the cycle and generate committee email
email_body = orch.close_cycle()

print("=== Committee Email ===")
print(email_body)

```

The output of this cell shows:

- The initial loan state and required documents
- The state transition after a partial document upload
- The status after running the completeness check
- The final executive summary email generated for the committee

This demonstrates that the orchestrator and agents work together as a coherent, testable system.

# Summary: From Prototype to Production

The prototype demonstrates:

- Modular agents
- A deterministic orchestrator

## Strategic deployment in a credit instituition

The system needs:

- Credit policy embedding - possibly connect a policy knowledge base (RAG)
- Enterprise infrastructure
- Security and compliance hardening
- LLM governance
- Integration with existing credit systems
- UI and workflow tooling
- Operational readiness


## Tactical deployment in a credit instituition
Since this is a stand-alone workflow and with an additional manual step to the credit systems it can be built and deployed tactically

### Pros

- Time to market
- Good 1st POC for agentic ai
- Deployed within one department
- Displaces one or two FTEs
- Makes efficient use of executive time
- Builds executive trust in agentic ai

### Cons

- May be seen as too simple
- If designed without strategic intent it will die
